license: Composite contains CC BY 4.0 and CC BY-NC 4.0 material. Credit both creators and retain noncommercial use for this combined model.
limitations: Original artist did not identify an exact model year; do not claim an OEM-accurate 2013 trim.
Source front/rear fenders and lower sill contain uneven or simplified surfaces. Limited fairing and welded normals improve appearance but do not turn the source into a manufacturer CAD replica.
Donor cabin is low-detail and adapted to fit. Added door cards, compartment liners and presentation hinge positions are approximations, not factory mechanisms.
Tire image maps are omitted from the composite; source wheel geometry is preserved.
Physical iPhone/Safari/Android performance and final production deployment have not been tested here.

modifications.name: object001_int_0
modifications.operation: Lowered donor cabin 55 mm; removed donor rear cargo shelf behind z=-1.25 m so it does not obstruct the early hatch opening; runtime cargo liner fills this cavity
Removed original distorted wheel assemblies; reused separately attributed iSteven wheels, straightened their pose and aligned the rear axle to the early wheel arches.

Runtime geometric articulation separates source early doors/windows/lids and adds simple door cards, armrests, storage pockets, front firewall and recessed cargo liners. Fixed windshield stays attached to the body.
